name: 3dcodeverse
description: Make real 3D with raw code: Blender bpy, CadQuery, Three.js, URDF, GLSL and OpenGL objects, mechanisms, scenes and shader effects. Skills carry the workflow and each language's measured contract; the 3dcode command-line instruments build, measure, render and gate the result.

interface.shortDescription: Raw-code 3D objects, mechanisms, scenes and shaders, measured
interface.longDescription: The agent writes raw Blender bpy, CadQuery, Three.js, URDF, GLSL or moderngl code in a workspace; the 3dcode instruments build it, export it, measure it against the plan, render it and run deterministic gates; a separate judge step scores the renders against a rubric.
defaultPrompt: Make a mid-century wooden dining chair in Blender bpy with 3dcodeverse
Make a kitchen cabinet with one door and a drawer as a URDF mechanism
Make a small Japanese garden at dusk with a koi pond as a three.js scene
